forward_5d_rv.description: 5-day realized vol (annualized, sqrt(252)*std(daily_ret)) over the 5 calendar days following entry_date, vs trailing_rv (90-day window ending T-5)

max_dd_post10d.description: Max drawdown (peak-to-trough on daily closes, sign-negative if spot falls) in the 10 calendar days after the expiry_date. Path object — not directional return (RO-3/F-21).

range_compression.description: (5d pre-expiry daily high-low range) / ATR(20) vs 20d trailing ATR baseline.  Captures pin/compression behavior into expiry.
